actual: docs/standards lacks a clear active-standards index. Historical development standard versions are already under docs/standards/archive, but agents launched outside the repo or without explicit guidance may still discover multiple versions and read archived standards. Expected: keep old versions in archive, add a current active standards README/index that marks v1.5 as the only active development standard and states archive files must not be read unless the user explicitly asks for historical context.
